notes.title: Our first Patch
notes.notes:
Greetings!

We're releasing our first patch today that should make the game much better in terms of playability as well as fixing a number of player reported issues. Please find the full patch notes below:


Changes:
More resolution options
VSync option
D-Pad works in the main menu
Button hints with improved readability
Corrected over 35 collision issues/problems
Other minor improvements

Bug fixes:
- Several collision problems throughout the game
- Camera transitions and positions
- In some conditions the player couldn't enter the room where the tree is planted
- Text corrections
- Pause in the snow chapter
- Player could get stuck on the branch in the windy chapter
- Player would die too early if you fell from an edge (underwater)
- In some conditions the player couldn't jump and/or attack anymore

Thanks for your continued support!
